title: filago germanica var. eriocephala
intro: Filago germanica var. eriocephala, commonly known as German Daisy or Rough Cockscomb, is a perennial herb in the family Asteraceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have been shown to have antimicrobial and hepatoprotective effects. Further research is needed to confirm the specific health benefits and therapeutic actions of German Daisy, but it has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various ailments.
